tools.name: get_form_snippet
tools.description: Returns working contact form code that posts to sendm8, a free form backend that emails each submission to the site owner. No account or API key needed. Use this whenever the user wants a contact, feedback or enquiry form that sends them email, on any static site, SPA or AI-built app. Pass the owner

tools.name: get_docs
tools.description: Returns one section of the sendm8 docs as Markdown: special fields, AJAX responses and status codes, redirects, spam protection, uploads, webhooks, Discord, Resend BYOK, or moving from Formspree.

tools.name: get_limits
tools.description: Returns sendm8's free plan limits as plain text: submissions per form per month, the no-account cap, instant emails per day, file sizes and rate limits.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_form_snippet, get_limits · Private data: get_form_snippet, get_limits · Public sink: get_form_snippet.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_form_snippet, get_limits · Private data: get_form_snippet, get_limits · Public sink: get_form_snippet

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
